name: Substrate Memory
description: Substrate retrieval and completed-turn capture for OpenClaw (memory_search, memory_expand, memory_evidence). Device onboarding plus the 0600 token file is the supported auth path; never store secrets in plugin config (openclaw.json is plaintext).

server.description: Substrate server connection. Explicit SUBSTRATE_* env vars always win.

python.description: Python interpreter for the vendored core (default: python3). Lowest precedence: SUBSTRATE_PYTHON env wins, then this key.
